nom: DHC Face Wash Powder Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil and reduces blackheads/bumps without over-drying, and one calls it the only creamy-type cleanser her oily skin tolerates.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it cleanses without stripping or tightening, but two report it worsens dryness, causing burning or tightness on eyelids/cheeks or advising against use in dry climates.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report balanced results (less oiliness in oily zones, no new dryness), though one with oily-leaning combination skin found it ineffective at removing makeup without heavy scrubbing.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including those with rosacea or fragrance allergies) mostly report no irritation, redness, or breakouts and describe it as one of few tolerable cleansers, but one reviewer developed a rash and bumps after combining it with chemical exfoliants.
segments.normal: Little is said specifically about normal skin beyond one reviewer noting her oily/combination skin began behaving more like normal skin after use.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature/aging skin (including ages 65-76) report soft, smooth, non-dry skin and long-term daily or weekly use without issues.

concerns.aging: Older reviewers (60s-70s) report soft, smooth skin and long-term satisfaction; no negative reports specific to aging skin, though one notes it's unsuitable for dry climates.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it cleanses without stripping or tightening skin; however, a minority report it leaves skin feeling tight, dry, or stripped, and one describes burning dryness on the cheeks and eyelids.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report calming effects with no flare-ups from regular use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with fragrance allergy and sensitive combination skin reports no allergic rash but significant dryness/burning in some areas; others with sensitive skin report no barrier disruption at all.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduction in blackheads and whiteheads, with one noting blackheads cleared after one use and another after consistent use; fungal acne is described as minimized but not resolved by one reviewer.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer breakouts, faded blemishes, or no new breakouts after starting use; one reviewer instead developed small bumps and breakouts after combining it with frequent chemical exfoliation.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily skin report reduced oiliness and clearer oily zones after regular use, including improvement described within one to two weeks.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling clean not stripped
Poor makeup and waterproof mascara removal

extraits.texte: Bought this product for the first time recently and had used for around a week with no problems. However, in the past few days my skin texture has completely changed and I have broke out with small bumps all over my face. My face also feels tight and itchy at times. It's definitely this product that has caused the reaction, as all my other products I have been using for weeks or months with no irritation. I think maybe because this product is exfoliating as well as cleansing... I also use chemical exfoliants about 3 times a week and doing that in combination with this product was obviously not good idea! Would recommend not using this product if you also exfoliate with serums/washes often. It's a shame as I love DHC, especially their cleansing oil!

I really wanted to love this product, but unlike other reviewers, this cleanser makes the dry areas of my face even drier. Specifically my eyelids and outer cheeks; they get so dry that it starts to burn (like a sunburn, even though I'm stuck indoors because of COVID) and I have to use Aquaphor to lessen the discomfort. I have sensitive combination skin and I'm allergic to fragrances. This product gets 3 stars because it does not trigger any allergy-related rashes and it cleanses well the oily areas of my face. It has also not triggered my acne-prone skin. I would only recommend it for those with sensitive and super oily skin, but not for dry skin. I'm so sad because other reviews mentioned that this cleanser is good for dry skin... It makes me question if maybe I received a bad batch... It could have been perfect for me, but the burning dryness is a major deal breaker...

I have tried many, many cleansers and moisturizers on my sensitive, rosacea prone face and this gentle wash has been the best of all of them. I wash with this and then use the Olive Virgin Oil Crystal Skin Essence with a tiny amount of the Olive Virgin Oil Essential Cream. This trio has left my 65 yr. old sensitive skin soft, smooth, and free of redness and bumps that had before. Please don't ever discontinue this!

extraits.titre: SOO GOOD FOR ALL SKIN TYPES!!
extraits.texte: First off id like to say i have like extremely oily skin!! i got this product as a free sample and i was immediately extremely impressed. the next day i went to buy it!! As soon as i rinsed this off my face felt sooo soft and hyrdated. it brightened my skin and my face had that natural glow from within look and appearance wise so much more brighter and radiant!! I was so shocked tbh. this is amazing if you have sensitive skin aswell. The past couple days ive been using this its faded my blemishs and these tiny dots on my face ive been struggling to get rid of! it takes a couple times to fully learn how to properly use but one you do its amazing. Since i have super oily skin my skin usually hates hyrdating and super creamy cleansers but this is literally the only exception lmaoo. i would totally recommend trying this. price is also really fair!

extraits.titre: Don't let the little bottle fool you!
extraits.texte: I gave this bottle the side eye when I got it because how small it was, but this stuff will last me a LONG time!! You seriously only need a SMALL pea size amount and it does the job. I use this with the DHC cleansing oil as a 2-step cleanse... and my skin is looking so much better!! Usually after washing my face.. it would go back to having my stupid oily zones looking gross again no matter what routine I tried, but I was amazed after only the 2nd time using this new combo, my face wasnt as oily as it usually would get... my skin is usually oily/combo with the oily parts getting super oily, and now my skin is starting to behave like its 'normal' skin. Absolutely will continue to use and purchase!!!

extraits.titre: The best face wash powder ever?!
extraits.texte: This is such an amazing face wash! I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this face wash is one of only a few that I can use without any irritation whatsoever! It leaves your skin soft and does not strip your skin if it's natural oils! I love this one just as much as the Dermalogica microfoliant, I use that when I need a deep clean with aha's and bha's. This is a great face wash!

extraits.titre: It's good but doesn't help with removing makeup
extraits.texte: I wear a full face if makeup throughout the day and the cleanser does a terrible job of removing it , it did take some off but I had to excessively scrub my face which is bad for your skin , I have combination skin which is mostly on the oily side and when trying to remove my makeup it makes it like a waterproof substance that doesn't come off until I grab some soap and take it off , it's good for a clean face but not for makeup removal
